data.Q: What does the young Levite seek when he leaves the town?
data.A: The young Levite seeks another place to stay.
data.wrong_answer: The young Levite seeks Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.

data.Q: Where had the young Levite been living before he left?
data.A: The young Levite had been living within the clan of Judah.
data.wrong_answer: The young Levite had been living in the hill country of Ephraim.

data.Q: What place does the young Levite reach on the way?
data.A: The young Levite comes to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.
data.wrong_answer: The young Levite comes to Bethlehem in Judah.

data.Q: Who leaves the town in search of a place to stay?
data.A: The young Levite leaves the town.
